title: Madad ko Ayiye ya shahe karbala meri
body:
MADAD KO AAIIYE YAA SHAH E KARBALA MERI
<<DIVIDER>>
YE AAQRI MERE MAULA HAI ILTEJAA MERI
Zameen e karbobala hai jafa ka nargha hai
Badan yateem ka paamaal hone wala hai
Sunega kaun musibat me ab sadaa meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Na poochiye saremaidaan kya musibat hai
Adoo hai darpayeaazaar waqte ghurbat hai
Bikharna jaaye kahi laash jaabajaa meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachi hai chand hi saansey ajeeba alam hai
Bas ek deed ki pyaasi ye chashme purnam hai
Ghadi hai aaqri aye hujjat e khuda meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Thaa jisne baba Hasan se kiya aahad todaa
Thaa jisne sulha ki shartao se apna moo modaa
Jawab zulm ka ab bangayi wigha meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Na jaane zulm o sitam kya karenge baniye shar
Na jaane qatm ho kis haal me wafa ka safar
Qabar to leejiye Ammoo mere zara meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabar nadeejiye amma ko mere marne ki
Na sehsakegi ye sadmaa yaqee hai kubra bhi
Mai jaanta ho ke nazdeek hai qazaa meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajeeb haal hai ek roz ki bihaayi ka
Muaal kya yehi hota hai be gunaahi ka
Dulhan hai aaj mere gham me mubtela meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Zubaan e khusk se aawaaz doo to kaise doo
Sadaa bhi halq me atki hui hai kya bolo
Hui hai pyaas bhi ab sabraazmaa meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Na mautaayi na jeene ki koi chaahat hai
Har ek zaqm har ek saans bhi azeeyat hai
Na jaane mujh se hai taqdeer kyun qafaa meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Zameen e garm hai Sadiq ke lab pe naala hai
Huzoora aiiye ab dum nikal ne waala hai
Qareeba agaayi manzil bohat chacha meri
<<MINI>>
Madad ko aaiiyeya shah e karbala meri
